system.description: You etch runes into a statue or a tree.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and you may speak with the spirit from anywhere once per day.
outcomes.success: You bind a willing or neutral spirit to the object. For a year and a day, it defends the area and warns you of intruders.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; no spirit answers.
outcomes.ruin: A spirit answers, but it is neither willing nor neutral. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
